name: contract_feed_not_ready_retry
description: Contract test for the feed-not-ready path: a VDFirst delta immediately followed by a checksum confirm, the pattern that hits 503+Retry-After while the vulnerability feed is still downloading. The sender re-encodes on every Retry-After wait (not a byte-identical resend, unlike plain backpressure retries) so Start.feed_offset stays whatever -vd-feed-offset/the agent's learned value is right up to the send that finally lands, bounded by --feed-timeout, until the feed becomes ready. In uds mode there is no /control to learn an offset from, so this still declares 0 unless -vd-feed-offset is passed explicitly -- if the target's feed settles on a nonzero offset, run with -vd-feed-offset matching it, or the VDFirst session gets a 409 version_mismatch instead of the 200 this scenario expects.
